Organize and prioritize a variety of projects and multiple tasks in an effective and timely manner; organize own work, set priorities, and meet critical time deadlines.

Effectively communicate in-person, over the telephone, and in writing.

jobs.title: Health and Safety Systems and Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are Forestry England.

We live and breathe forests.

Job title – Health and Safety Systems and Project Manager

Salary - £41,802 - £44,830

Contract type – Fixed Term Appointment Until 31st March 2029, with the possibility of extension or permanency

Hours – 37 hours per week

Vacancy Closes
- 29th November, 23:55

Join us. We're foresters, professionals and experts. We are a passionate team who love to share our enthusiasm and want to make a positive difference for you and the environment.

Together, we’re using our scale and expertise to grow the nation’s forests for everyone. We’re already adapting our landscapes for tomorrow, and getting stuff done today, like creating amazing places and experiences for you to enjoy. We're providing vital homes for wildlife, making our air cleaner to breathe and producing sustainable timber.

What You’ll Do…

We have an exciting opportunity to join our Health, Safety and Technical Training Team. The Health and Safety Systems and Project Manager will take a lead role in shaping, guiding and embedding H&S software, systems and processes across the DEFRA funded Biodiversity Programme.

The Health, Safety and Technical Training (HSTT) team has a focus on managing risks to our staff, volunteers, contractors and visitors. Ensuring competence at all levels including operator, management and leadership skills. HSTT work closely with function heads, team leaders and staff groups to evaluate compliance, health and safety priorities and training needs across the org

Please see the job description for more information and details about what we need from you.

Where you’ll work…

The role will be based in any Forestry England office preferably within the Midlands, with flexibility for blended working (with the ability to commute to the local Forestry England office regularly).

There will be a need for travel in this role, with occasional overnight stays necessary.

Please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas.

Benefits…

Alongside your salary, Forestry England contributes an average of 28.97% towards your pension. You will become a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension Scheme.

Other Benefits Include

25 days holiday a year, raising by one day every year’s service, up to 30 days (pro-rated for part time employees) plus additional days off such as bank holidays.
STaR is our employee benefits scheme offering discounts on everyday supermarket shopping, as well as other things such as hotel stays clothes, mobile phones, other electrical items, medical and car insurance, holidays, gym discounts, household bills, Headspace wellbeing app.
free parking at Forestry England sites and free entry to our National Arboretums at Westonbirt and Bedgebury.
a commitment to lifelong learning through career development. Forestry England will support your career development in a variety of ways, including continual professional development, support for individual learning plans and sponsored membership of professional bodies.

Read more about the benefits on the Forestry England website.

How To Apply…

We cannot accept applications via email. Please follow the steps outlined below. Any CVs and/or personal statements sent outside the system will not be considered for shortlisting.

You will be asked to write a 200 word statement on your relevant experience and career history, along with a personal statement of no more than 500 words. You will be assessed on both during sifting. More details about how to apply are listed on the application form.

The selection process may include additional assessment and/or interview stages. Candidates will be informed of the assessment format and arrangements during the recruitment process.

The Behaviours being assessed at interview are –

Communicating and Influencing
Changing and Improving
Working together
Managing a Quality Service

You may also be assessed on Experience, Strength based questions, and/or the Technical Success Profile at the interview. The technical element could include a presentation, practical or written task.

If candidates pass the interview but are not the leading candidate, they can be placed on a reserve list. We may offer candidates on the reserve list for this role the opportunity to be considered for other roles at the same or lower pay bands.

Internal: Please note that if you are an internal candidate on a permanent contract and you apply for a Fixed Term Appointment of three years or more, your substantive role will not be held open. You will retain your permanent status. At the end of the FTA, HR and your new Cost Centre Manager will attempt to find you a suitable alternative post in line with the Redeployment policy. If no suitable alternative post can be found, you will be managed under Redundancy policy.

If you move to a post in a higher pay band through fair and open competition for a period of less than three years, then you will be considered to be on a period of ‘temporary promotion’, if three years or more then you will be considered to be permanently promoted .

Successful candidates will undergo a criminal record check and the government baseline personnel security standard check.

If you require any reasonable adjustments, please email fcrecruitmentteam@forestryengland.uk.

If you're planning to use AI to support your application, please ensure you've read our guidelines here first.

Read more about our application process and working with us on the Forestry England website.

Nationality Requirements…

Read more about nationality requirements for working in the Civil Service on GOV.UK.

Working for the Civil Service…

Forestry England is part of the Civil Service. The Civil Service has a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS). This means candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria during the application process will be guaranteed an interview. We also offer a Redeployment Interview Scheme to current civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the role. This role is also part of the Great Place to Work for Veterans and Prison Leaver Recruitment initiative.

This role is funded by DEFRA rather than through Forestry England generated revenue and is therefore subject to government spending reviews. While DEFRA has indicated long term support for the Biodiversity Programme and we expect funding to continue, it is possible that funding levels may change at the end of any financial year depending on DEFRA’s budget allocations. In the event of funding changes, we would prioritise retaining staff posts wherever possible. This approach is consistent for roles within publicly funded organisations. We are committed to keeping staff informed and supported through any changes.

Within Part 7 of the Immigration Act 2016, it is essential that applicants should have the ability to provide conversation in accurate spoken English.

Our recruitment process makes appointments based on fair and open competition and merit, as outlined in the Civil Service Commissioners’ Recruitment Principles. If you feel your application has not been treated in in line with/according to these principles and you wish to make a complaint, please email: englandhr.services@forestryengland.uk.

jobs.title: Solutions Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
The Software Development Manager (SDM) is responsible for the effective delivery and management of software development teams across multiple client projects. The role provides leadership across delivery, people, technical coordination, client engagement, resource management, reporting, and continuous improvement. The SDM is accountable for ensuring that projects are delivered within agreed scope, timeline, quality, and commercial parameters, while maintaining strong client relationships and building a high-performing, accountable, and engaged software development team. The SDM works closely with clients, Project Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, Developers, Testers, and internal management to ensure successful project outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

• Work with clients and subject matter experts to understand business requirements and desired outcomes.
• Ensure requirements are sufficiently defined, understood, and agreed before development commences.
• Ensure requirements are translated into appropriate functional artefacts, including user stories, business processes, and user interface requirements where applicable.
• Ensure the product backlog is appropriately defined, prioritised, and maintained.
• Facilitate effective backlog refinement and requirements clarification.
• Work with the delivery and technical teams to estimate implementation effort.
• Ensure assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, and scope boundaries are clearly documented.
• Support resolution of client acceptance issues against agreed scope and requirements.
• Ensure development does not commence where requirements, scope, assumptions, or acceptance criteria are materially unclear or unresolved.
• Estimate project delivery effort across the software development lifecycle.
• Define project delivery plans, timelines, milestones, resource requirements, and delivery approach.
• Monitor project progress against agreed scope, schedule, quality, resource, and financial metrics.
• Manage project scope and ensure adherence to the change control process.
• Identify, manage, and escalate project risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
• Ensure appropriate delivery governance, reporting, and documentation.
• Prepare and present regular project status reports to DBR and client stakeholders, ensuring alignment on project health, progress, risks, issues, dependencies, financials, resources, and decisions required.
• Maintain stakeholder engagement and proactively manage expectations.
• Ensure stakeholder approval and acceptance of project deliverables.
• Ensure adherence to DBR project delivery assurance and governance standards.
• Intervene and provide direction where projects are at risk of missing agreed outcomes.

Qualifications

• At least 7 years of experience in software development and/or technology delivery.
• At least 3 years of experience in a people leadership, delivery management, software development management, or equivalent leadership role.
• Demonstrated experience managing software development teams and multiple concurrent projects.
• Demonstrated experience in client-facing delivery and stakeholder management.
• Demonstrated experience in project estimation, planning, resource management, and delivery governance.
• Demonstrated experience in project reporting and stakeholder communication.
• Experience working with Agile software development methodologies.
• Experience working with Technical Leads, Architects, Developers, Testers, Business Analysts, and Product Owners.
• Experience supporting pre-sales, solution definition, or commercial activities is desirable.

About the Role We are looking for a Project Manager / Account Manager who can own relationships with our international enterprise clients end to end — from onboarding and scope definition through day-to-day delivery, reporting and growth. You will be the single point of contact for clients across time zones, working closely with internal ecommerce, catalogue, content and technology teams to deliver marketplace and product data programmes accurately, on time and at scale.
The ideal candidate is equally comfortable on a client call and inside a marketplace seller portal — someone who speaks the language of SKUs, ASINs, listings, buy boxes, content enrichment and marketplace compliance, and can translate that into clear plans, timelines and commercial outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
Client & Account Management Act as the primary point of contact for assigned enterprise accounts, building trusted, long-term relationships with client stakeholders across geographies.
Run structured client communication — weekly status calls, business reviews (MBRs/QBRs), escalation handling and proactive updates across time zones.
Understand client business objectives, catalogue volumes, marketplace footprint and growth plans, and translate them into a clear scope of work and account roadmap.
Maintain account health documentation: scope, SLAs, KPIs, RAID logs, action trackers and meeting minutes.
Identify upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts and work with internal teams to convert them.

Project Delivery & Coordination Own end-to-end project delivery: requirement gathering, workback schedules, resource allocation, quality checkpoints and on-time closure.
Coordinate daily with internal production, catalogue, content, creative and tech teams to keep delivery on track and unblock issues fast.
Manage multiple concurrent accounts and workstreams without letting quality or turnaround slip.
Track effort, capacity and utilisation against contracted scope; flag risks and scope creep early with a recommended solution.
Prepare and present delivery dashboards, SLA/quality reports and volume trend analysis to clients and internal leadership.

Ecommerce, Marketplace & Product Data Expertise Apply a working knowledge of marketplaces (Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Zalando, Flipkart, Noon, TikTok Shop, Shopify and similar) to guide clients on operational best practice.
Oversee product data and catalogue operations: listing creation, bulk uploads, flat-file/template handling, variation (parent-child) structures, content enrichment, image and A+ content requirements, and data quality standards.
Guide teams on marketplace-specific rules and concepts — buy box, FBA/FBM, seller central, catalogue matching, suppression, compliance documentation, returns, reviews and performance metrics.
Review and validate product data for completeness, attribute accuracy and taxonomy/classification adherence before client hand-off.
Support onboarding of new marketplaces and new categories, including requirement mapping and process documentation.

Process, Quality & Documentation Create and maintain SOPs, checklists and quality frameworks for recurring delivery work.
Drive continuous improvement — cut turnaround time, reduce rework and raise first-time-right quality on client deliverables.
Train and mentor junior team members on client processes, marketplace concepts and communication standards.
Ensure adherence to client confidentiality, data security and compliance requirements.

Must-Have Requirements 3-5 years of experience in project management, account management or client servicing — with at least 2 year in an ecommerce, marketplace or product data environment.
Excellent spoken and written English communication — clear, confident and client-ready, with the ability to run calls independently with international stakeholders.
Proven experience coordinating with clients across the globe (US, UK, EU, APAC), including comfort with overlapping shifts and asynchronous communication.
Strong understanding of ecommerce terms and concepts — listings, SKUs, ASINs, catalogue, variation families, taxonomy/attributes, content enrichment, buy box, fulfilment models, marketplace compliance.
Hands-on familiarity with marketplace seller platforms and/or product information systems (PIM), bulk uploads and data templates.
Solid project management skills — planning, prioritisation, dependency tracking, risk management and multi-account handling.
Strong working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets (VLOOKUP, pivots, filters) and reporting tools; comfortable with project tools such as Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Trello or Monday.com.
High ownership, accountability and attention to detail — you follow through and close loops without being chased.
Willing and able to work from the office full-time, from ZIRAKPUR, SAS Nagar (Mohali), Punjab

Good to Have Prior experience servicing global / enterprise clients in an agency, BPO/KPO, ecommerce services or marketplace consulting set-up.
Working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central / Vendor Central, Walmart Seller Center, Shopify admin, or marketplace analytics tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Keepa).
Exposure to digital marketing, content operations, Amazon Advertising (PPC) or marketplace analytics.
Experience with PIM/DAM tools, data migration projects or catalogue automation.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Security Operations Analyst (L1) – MS Defender based in India.

As a Security Operations Analyst, you will play an important role in protecting enterprise IT environments through continuous security monitoring and first-level incident response. You will be responsible for monitoring Microsoft Defender security alerts, identifying suspicious activities, and performing initial investigations to help detect potential threats. Working within a global security operations environment, you will support endpoint protection, validate device security status, and ensure incidents are properly documented and escalated. You will collaborate with SOC specialists, infrastructure teams, and senior security analysts to support effective threat detection and response. By following established security procedures and operational runbooks, you will contribute to maintaining a strong security posture across enterprise environments. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your cybersecurity expertise in a collaborative, fast-paced, and continuously evolving technical environment.

Accountabilities

Monitor Microsoft Defender: Continuously monitor Microsoft Defender portals, security dashboards, alert queues, and incident notifications to identify potential security threats and endpoint protection issues.
Perform initial alert triage: Review malware detections, suspicious activities, and endpoint security alerts, assessing device information, severity levels, timestamps, and potential business impact.
Validate endpoint protection: Perform basic checks on Defender sensor health, endpoint onboarding status, protection configurations, and security coverage.
Identify security vulnerabilities and issues: Detect endpoints with failed scans, outdated security intelligence, inactive sensors, or other protection-related problems and report them through established procedures.
Escalate potential threats: Identify suspicious activities and high-severity alerts and escalate them promptly to L2/L3 analysts and relevant security teams according to established escalation procedures.
Manage security incidents: Create, categorize, prioritize, and update incident tickets using ServiceNow or equivalent IT Service Management platforms.
Collect investigation evidence: Gather and document relevant alert information, device details, timestamps, and initial investigation findings to support further analysis.
Execute security runbooks: Perform approved first-level investigation and validation activities by following documented security procedures and operational guidelines.
Coordinate incident resolution: Track open incidents and collaborate with L2/L3 analysts, SOC teams, and endpoint specialists throughout investigation and remediation activities.
Validate remediation activities: Confirm endpoint protection recovery and remediation status as instructed by senior security teams, ensuring incidents are accurately updated.
Follow security procedures: Respect established authorization boundaries and escalation protocols, avoiding unauthorized containment or remediation actions.
Maintain operational compliance: Follow security incident management, incident, change, and service request processes while ensuring timely alert acknowledgement and SLA compliance.
Document operational activities: Maintain accurate incident records, operational checklists, investigation notes, and shift handover documentation.
Collaborate across teams: Coordinate with SOC, Endpoint, Identity, Infrastructure, and L2/L3 teams to support effective security operations.
Support reporting and improvement: Contribute to routine security reports, alert tracking, and operational reviews while identifying recurring alerts and reporting monitoring or documentation gaps.
Ensure global monitoring continuity: Facilitate effective handovers across APAC, EMEA, and North America teams to maintain uninterrupted 24/7 security monitoring.

Requirements

Professional experience: 1–3 years of experience in IT operations, security monitoring, endpoint support, or security incident management.
Endpoint security knowledge: Basic understanding of endpoint protection technologies, antivirus solutions, malware detection, and common security alerts.
Microsoft Defender expertise: Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent endpoint protection platforms. Practical experience with Microsoft Defender is highly desirable.
Windows operating systems: Basic knowledge of Windows environments, system processes, endpoint health, and troubleshooting fundamentals.
Security alert investigation: Ability to review security alerts, identify relevant information, collect evidence, and follow documented investigation procedures.
Incident management: Understanding of incident severity levels, escalation matrices, response procedures, and SLA requirements.
ITSM tools: Familiarity with ServiceNow or equivalent IT Service Management platforms for incident logging, tracking, and documentation.
Communication skills: Good written and verbal communication abilities, with the capacity to provide clear investigation updates and accurate shift handovers.
Documentation and organization: Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate incident records while following established security procedures.
Shift flexibility: Willingness to work rotational shifts in a 24/7 security operations environment, supporting global teams and continuous monitoring.
Security certifications: Microsoft SC-900 or an equivalent security fundamentals certification is an advantage.
Extended security knowledge: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel is desirable.
Threat awareness: Understanding of malware, phishing, endpoint threats, and common cyberattack techniques is beneficial.
Scripting and troubleshooting: Basic knowledge of PowerShell and Windows troubleshooting is a plus.
Security analytics: Exposure to Kusto Query Language (KQL), security dashboards, alert analysis, and incident reporting is desirable.
ITIL knowledge: Familiarity with ITIL principles and security incident management processes is an advantage.
Key competencies: Knowledge of security monitoring, Microsoft Defender, alert triage, endpoint protection, basic threat analysis, evidence collection, runbook execution, incident logging, escalation management, SLA compliance, and global 24/7 operations.

Benefits

Remote flexibility: Fully remote working arrangement within India.
Professional development: Opportunities to develop expertise in cybersecurity, endpoint protection, and enterprise security operations.
Technical exposure: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender, security monitoring platforms, incident management tools, and modern security technologies.
Continuous learning: Opportunities to strengthen technical skills through practical security investigations, operational activities, and exposure to emerging threats.
Career progression: Opportunity to grow within security operations and develop advanced incident response and threat investigation capabilities.
Collaborative environment: Work alongside experienced security professionals and international technical teams.

jobs.title: TPO Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Description

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a TPO Business Analyst to join our TPO Business Strategy team to serve as the analytical engine connecting product development, operations, and enterprise partner feedback. This role will own product and process gap analysis — identifying where our TPO platform falls short against enterprise partner needs, investor requirements, and operational best practices — and translate those findings into actionable requirements for engineering and process improvements for operations. The ideal candidate will have experience in solar finance, business analysis, or operations and will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Capital Markets, and Risk teams.  

This position will be based out of San Francisco, CA or Santa Clara, CA with an in-office schedule set at the direct manager’s discretion in accordance with the company policies and procedures. 

Responsibilities

Conduct end-to-end product and process gap analyses by mapping the TPO customer journey (sale creation through asset onboarding), identifying structural gaps, and categorizing them by severity and business impact — similar in scope to internal initiatives like Project Clarity.  
Translate voice-of-customer feedback from enterprise installer partners and investor/capital markets stakeholders into structured product requirements and operational process change proposals for Engineering and Operations teams.  
Own change order and milestone enforcement analysis — evaluate current process controls (e.g., CO enforcement at NTP, M2 as-built verification, Year 1 kWh reconciliation), identify attack vectors and failure modes, and design minimum viable fixes that require no or minimal engineering development.  
Build detailed gap analysis deliverables (Word docs, Excel models, process flow diagrams) that clearly articulate current state vs. target state, root cause, and prioritized remediation paths with implementation timelines. 
Partner with the Operations team to redesign operational process flows when gaps are identified — drafting new SOPs, updating milestone checklists, and coordinating rollout across QSS and internal ops stakeholders.  
Support product development prioritization by maintaining a living backlog of product gaps mapped to partner impact, investor risk, and revenue exposure — enabling data-driven sprint planning conversations with Engineering.  
Analyze PI (Partner Installer) behavior patterns using Salesforce data to identify systemic risks such as production overstatement, CO circumvention, and documentation non-compliance, and recommend systemic controls.  
Participate in cross-functional project meetings (e.g., CLS issue mapping, PMO-led initiatives) and produce structured meeting notes, action item trackers, and follow-up deliverables.   

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, data analytics, or a related field with a minimum of 5+ years of professional work experience in business analysis, operations analysis, management consulting, or strategy/operations role in solar finance, fintech, or financial services. 
Strong analytical skills with the ability to map complex multi-step processes, identify failure points, and propose structured solutions — comfort with process flow mapping and root cause analysis. 
Proficiency in Excel (financial modeling, data analysis) and PowerPoint (structured presentations for leadership audiences). 
Excellent written communication — ability to produce clear, structured gap analysis documents, SOPs, and requirements specifications. 
Comfort working across multiple teams simultaneously (Product, Engineering, Operations, Capital Markets) in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in residential solar TPO operations, loan servicing, or asset management — familiarity with milestone-based workflows (NTP, M1, M2, M3). 
Familiarity with Salesforce as a system of record and experience pulling operational data for analysis. 
Exposure to investor reporting, capital markets due diligence, or portfolio quality analysis in a renewable energy or structured finance context. 
Experience with process improvement frameworks (Lean, Six Sigma) or project management tools (Jira, Asana, Miro). 
SQL or BI tool experience (Tableau, Looker) for operational data analysis is a plus. 

WHY QCELLS?:

This is an opportunity to lead an end-to-end North American BESS business and shape its strategy, growth, product portfolio, commercial model, supply chain, and execution platform.

The role offers direct executive visibility with Qcells and Hanwha leadership and the opportunity to build a scalable BESS organization across the North American market.

Qcells is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Compensation

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, the anticipated annual base salary for this position is:

Zone 1 (Bay Area, NYC): $120,400 – $144,400
Zone 2 (CA, NJ, NY): $110,300 – $132,300
Zone 3 (All others): $100,300 – $120,300

The applicable salary range is based on the employee’s primary work location. Individual compensation will be determined based on qualifications, relevant experience, education, skills, internal equity, and other business-related factors.

Hanwha Q CELLS America Inc. (“HQCA”) is a Qcells company, one of the world’s largest manufacturers and providers of solar photovoltaic (PV) products and solutions.  Headquartered in Irvine, California, HQCA has been rapidly expanding its business in North America through the expansion of products and solutions, including distributed energy solutions, direct-to-homeowner solar sales and financing, and EPC services.  We provide an opportunity to be part of an exciting and growing world-class global business in an interesting and expanding industry of the future.

This position requires the ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. Periodic travel and site visits may be required.

The salary range is required by the California Pay Transparency Act and may differ depending on the location of those candidates hired nationwide. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to, skill set, education, licenses and certifications, essential job duties and requirements, and the necessary experience relative to the job’s minimum qualifications.

This target salary range is for CA positions only and should not be interpreted as an offer of compensation.

jobs.title: Graduate Development Program, Associate Data Analyst, Electric Projects Estimating
jobs.description:
About The Position

Ready to turn data into insights that help power the future of energy? As an Associate Data Analyst, you'll use data to uncover trends, solve business challenges, and help drive smarter decisions across major electric infrastructure projects. Working with financial, project, and operational data, you'll transform complex information into meaningful insights that support the estimating team and contribute to the delivery of critical investments that keep communities connected.

In this role, you'll collaborate with estimators and stakeholders across the business to analyze data, build dashboards, create impactful reports, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency. You'll develop experience with data visualization, analytics, and emerging technologies while strengthening your technical, business, and communication skills. If you're naturally curious, enjoy solving problems, and want to see the real-world impact of your work, you'll thrive on this collaborative team that values fresh ideas, continuous learning, and innovation.

What You’ll Do

Analyze financial, project, and operational data to uncover trends, answer business questions, and support decision-making across capital electric projects.
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that help stakeholders turn data into actionable insights.
Partner with estimators and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and streamline workflows.
Support data extraction, validation, and reporting activities to help ensure information is accurate, reliable, and meaningful.
Present findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex data into clear takeaways.
Explore emerging analytics, automation, and AI tools while developing your technical, business, and problem-solving skills through real-world projects and collaboration.

What You'll Need to Apply

Bachelors or Master's degree from an accredited institution. Preferably in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a related field.
Problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate data, identify trends, and support business decisions.
Ability to communicate insights clearly and collaborate effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
Graduated between May 2026 and June 2027
Ability to begin the National Grid Graduate Program on June 7, 2027, or July 12, 2027
Valid driver’s license required with a safe driving history that meets National Grid’s Safe Driver policy
Work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States (such as sponsorship for an H-1B, TN, O, L, STEM OPT, or other employment-based work authorization)

It would be awesome if you had

Experience using tools like Python, SQL, Snowflake, or similar technologies to explore data, solve problems, and uncover insights.
Experience creating dashboards, reports, or data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or other reporting tools.
Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, or stakeholder engagement through student organizations, academic projects, internships, volunteer work, athletics, or extracurricular activities.

What You’ll Get in Return

Structured development opportunities, mentorship, and ongoing feedback to accelerate your career growth
Exposure to leaders, cross-functional teams, and diverse areas of the business
Opportunities to build your professional network and develop lasting industry connections
Meaningful work and real-world experience that provide a strong foundation for a long-term career at National Grid
Competitive salary ranging from $73,000 to $86,000, plus a comprehensive benefits package
Financial support for your future through up to $6,000 in student loan repayment assistance and tuition reimbursement benefits of up to $8,000 annually for undergraduate studies and $10,000 annually for graduate studies

About The Graduate Development Program

National Grid’s Graduate Development Program (GDP) is a year-long development program for recent college graduates who aspire to take on future leadership roles in a dynamic, ever-changing industry. Graduates will shape the future of National Grid. Bringing fresh thinking, new perspectives, and exploring with energy, we’ll give you real responsibility and an opportunity to move with purpose from day one – putting the power to supercharge your career in your hands.

Graduates start their careers at National Grid with an in-depth 3-week in-person Orientation which gives you exposure to all parts of the company, allows you to network with your Graduate cohort, GDP alumni, and senior leaders, and provides you with the opportunity to travel throughout our service territory in the northeast US. Following Orientation, you’ll begin working in the full-time position outlined below and take part in robust in-person and virtual development activities throughout the year. This includes monthly development sessions, active mentorship, and an intensive and immersive “Hackathon Project” where you “hack” a real-world National Grid problem.

About National Grid

National Grid is the critical energy infrastructure company, operating the electricity and gas networks and infrastructures that connects millions of people to the energy they use every day, supporting homes, businesses and communities across Massachusetts and New York.

We know the future of energy won't be shaped by what we know today. It will be shaped by what's possible tomorrow. That's why we're investing in the next generation of talent, giving undergraduates and graduates the opportunity to learn from experts, gain hands-on experience and contribute to work that matters from day one.

Are you ready to unlock the power of the possible?

More Information

Salary Range

Northboro or Waltham, Massachusetts $73,000 - $86,000 a year

National Grid will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. You must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

Please note US Colleagues must reside within our existing footprint, which includes Massachusetts, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Connecticut, New Hampshire, Maine, Rhode Island and Vermont. As a National Grid employee, you should also reside within a reasonable, commutable distance to your assigned primary office.

Applications close on December 1, 2026
. As we review applications on a rolling basis, this posting may close earlier if we receive a sufficient number of qualified applications. Early application is encouraged.

Our employment practices are designed to ensure that all individuals are treated fairly and with respect throughout the hiring process and during employment. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that is free from unlawful discrimination and harassment, and we encourage a culture of respect for all.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

Lead the delivery of major infrastructure projects that will help shape the future of Britain's electricity network.

At National Grid Electricity Transmission (NGET), we're delivering one of the largest investment programmes in a generation. As demand for electricity increases and new technologies transform the way we live and work, we're building the network needed to connect cleaner energy, support economic growth and power the UK's future.

As a Senior Project Manager, you'll lead and develop a team of Project Managers responsible for delivering a diverse portfolio of major infrastructure and customer connection projects across London. These projects play a critical role in enabling the UK's energy transition and digital growth, from connecting large-scale data centres supporting AI and emerging technologies, to delivering transmission network reinforcements, substations, HVDC projects, battery storage and renewable energy connections.

This is a highly visible leadership role with responsibility for both project delivery and people leadership. You'll provide direction, support and challenge to your team, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to the highest standards while creating an environment where people can develop and perform at their best.

Working across the full project lifecycle, you'll oversee the successful progression of projects from initial funding and optioneering through design, procurement, contract award, construction and commissioning. You'll work closely with internal and external stakeholders, delivery partners and contractors to manage risk, drive performance and achieve successful outcomes.

You'll also help shape how we deliver projects in the future, championing continuous improvement, strengthening collaboration across teams and sharing best practice across the wider business.

The scale, complexity and significance of this work is exceptional. Every project you deliver will help connect the customers, technologies and low-carbon energy sources that are driving the UK's future, leaving a lasting impact on the electricity network and the communities it serves.

Projects are located across London, so you'll need to be within commuting distance. The role combines time in project and site offices with travel throughout the region, alongside ad hoc home working.

What you'll bring

We're looking for an experienced project leader who combines strong delivery capability with the ability to motivate, develop and lead high-performing teams.

You'll bring:

Significant experience delivering complex construction, infrastructure, utilities or energy projects through design, procurement, delivery and commissioning.
Strong commercial and contractual management experience, with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and delivery partners to achieve successful project outcomes.
Experience managing projects within complex stakeholder environments and significant capital investment programmes.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Cyber Security Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of information security controls across Daman Securities and Daman Investments. The role manages the relationship with the Group's managed security service provider, runs vulnerability management and incident response, maintains security policies and the risk register, and supports regulatory and audit requests. The Cyber Security Manager reports to the Group CIO and executes the Group's information security program rather than setting Group strategy.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Security Operations & Incident Response

Manage the day-to-day relationship with the managed SOC / MSSP, including alert triage, escalation, and tracking performance against SLA.
Execute incident response playbooks, coordinate containment and recovery, and support post-incident review and regulatory notification under the Group CIO's direction.
Run the vulnerability management programme and coordinate penetration testing, tracking findings through to remediation.

Policy, Risk & Compliance Support

Maintain and update information security policies, standards, and procedures within the framework set by the Group CIO.
Maintain the information security risk register and produce regular reporting on risk position and remediation status.
Prepare evidence and coordinate responses for internal audit, external audit, and CMA regulatory requests on information security matters.
Support responses to institutional due diligence reviews and client security questionnaires for Daman Securities and Daman Investments clients.

Identity, Access & Data Security

Administer identity and access management processes, including joiner-mover-leaver workflows, privileged access, and periodic access recertification.
Support data classification, data loss prevention, and encryption standards, and test backup and recovery restorability.
Provide security input on change requests — new systems, integrations, and vendor onboarding — ahead of go-live.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Educational Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.

Technical Competencies

Working knowledge of security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, identity and access management, and data protection.
Familiarity with Microsoft 365 security tooling (Defender, Entra ID, Purview) and cloud security fundamentals.
Experience working with a managed SOC or MSSP provider.
Working knowledge of UAE information security expectations relevant to financial services (CMA, PDPL) is an advantage.

Skills/Personal Attributes

Structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to execute consistently against an established control framework.
Good communicator, comfortable working across IT, trading, wealth management, and HR/EOS teams.
High level of integrity and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.
Arabic language skills are an advantage.

Work Experience

5–8 years of experience in information security or IT risk, with hands-on exposure to SOC operations, vulnerability management, or identity and access management.
Experience in financial services is preferred but not required.
A relevant certification (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CISA, Security+) is preferred, or a willingness to obtain one.

As part of this team, you’ll build and lead the technical programme management function supporting our Data organisation. You’ll partner with Data and Engineering leadership to make valuable data immediately and reliably usable, combining hands-on ownership of flagship programmes with coaching and developing a small, high-impact TPM team.

🧠 Your day-to-day

Coach and support a small, high-impact TPM team, helping people develop their skills, work through challenges and raise the standard of programme delivery.
Act as a trusted delivery partner to Data and Engineering leadership, aligning priorities, challenging trade-offs and holding teams and leaders accountable for meaningful outcomes.
Work across data, ML, engineering and external data and annotation suppliers to manage dependencies, surface risks and remove blockers.
Use KPIs, dashboards and operational reviews to understand delivery progress, identify bottlenecks and steer decisions with the right data.
Represent the Data organisation in company-level reviews, communicating progress, risks and decisions clearly and connecting delivery to business impact.

🧩 What You’ll Be Working On

Building and scaling the technical programme management function for our Data organisation, hiring to fill capability gaps and growing a high-performing team.
Owning planning, prioritisation and execution across the data roadmap in partnership with Data leadership.
Leading flagship programmes directly across the data platform, ingestion and standardisation pipelines, enrichment and curation, labelling and annotation, and dataset management and quality.
Establishing scalable planning cadences, governance, escalation paths and operational practices that bring structure without slowing delivery.
Driving measurable improvements in data quality, throughput, cost and time-to-insight, making the data that powers our models more reliably and predictably available.

🙌 You Should Apply If

You bring 8+ years of deep, hands-on experience delivering data programmes as a technical programme manager, spanning data platforms, pipelines, enrichment, curation or labelling. You’ve built or scaled a programme function, led people and processes, and get things done with ownership and a bias for action.
You build, coach and grow high-performing teams. You know how to develop people, hire to strengthen the team and raise the bar on technical programme management.
You have strong technical depth across data platforms, pipelines and large-scale distributed infrastructure, including platforms operating at petabyte scale. You can engage credibly with engineers without being expected to write production code. Your experience includes:
Data ingestion from raw data through multiple processing stages and pipelines, with an understanding of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), their uses and their challenges.
A solid understanding of machine learning, GPUs, and training and inference for models with 500 million to 20 billion parameters.
Proficiency with some or all of Databricks, Flyte, Ray, Kubernetes, Azure, Docker and Python.
Proficiency with AI agents such as Cursor, Claude or Codex to accelerate execution.

You stay objective under pressure and adapt your approach in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. You bring structure and clarity without creating unnecessary process or slowing delivery.
You think in systems, understanding how the parts of a complex data platform fit together and how changes in one area affect others.
You’re product-minded, focusing on the people your programmes serve, prioritising by impact and defining what good looks like—not just tracking activity.
You align and influence across data, ML and engineering without relying on formal authority.
You connect data investment to measurable outcomes, including quality, throughput and cost, and communicate direction and progress clearly using the right metrics.
You’re open to feedback and continuously improve how you and your team work.
Ideally, you’ve worked with large-scale distributed data platforms used by hundreds of engineers and researchers.
Experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large-scale data and ML programmes would also be valuable.
An engineering or computer science degree, or experience working as an engineer, alongside fluency with modern delivery tools such as Jira, would be a plus.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More About Wayve

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)
Competency Interviews (TPM process, Cross-functional; 1 hour 45 minutes total)
Deep-dive technical interviews (Program Design, Leadership & Management; 1 hour 45 minutes total)
Final interview: mission & values alignment (30 minutes).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually

✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs

📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth

🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

new_jobs.description:
Your Job

DEPCOM Power, a leading renewable energy EPC firm, is seeking a Project Manager for the Southwest portfolio to lead the execution of utility-scale Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage, and Repowering projects from pre-construction through commissioning and closeout.

As a Project Manager, you will create long-term value by leading project teams that deliver safe, reliable, and profitable results. You will apply Principle Based Management to strengthen ownership, improve execution discipline, make sound economic decisions, and build trusted customer and stakeholder relationships from pre-construction through closeout.

This is a remote role that requires travel to field construction project sites at a frequency between 25% - 50% dependent on project need.

Our Team

DEPCOM's Project Delivery Organization executes turnkey PV, Battery Energy Storage, and Repower projects, including collection substations and generation transmission lines. The team partners with vendors, subcontractors, utilities, and internal capabilities to deliver disciplined project execution and strong customer outcomes nationwide.

What You Will Do

Lead project teams to deliver safe, reliable, and profitable outcomes across scope, schedule, cost, quality, compliance, and customer expectations.
Develop and execute project plans, forecasts, risk mitigation strategies, and phase-gate deliverables from pre-construction through commissioning and closeout.
Apply economic thinking to evaluate cost, risk, schedule, and value tradeoffs while making timely decisions that improve project outcomes.
Build and develop high-performing teams by setting clear expectations, coaching for contribution, and aligning strengths to project and business needs.
Coordinate customers, subcontractors, vendors, utilities, consultants, and internal partners to support transparent communication and disciplined execution.
Strengthen customer and stakeholder relationships by resolving challenges, honoring commitments, and creating mutual long-term value.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

Experience managing EPC, industrial, infrastructure, utility scale renewable energy, or large capital projects valued in the hundreds of millions of dollars
Experience managing project scope, schedule, cost, forecasting, risk mitigation, contracts, or customer commitments.
Experience leading project teams, subcontractors, vendors, or cross-functional stakeholders.
Valid US driver's license.
Legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship now or in the future.

What Will Put You Ahead

EPC experience in Utility Solar, Wind, BESS, conventional power or industrial projects.
Experience leading self-perform construction execution on large or complex projects.
Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
PMP, CCM, PE, or other relevant project management or construction industry certifications.
Experience partnering with Business Development, Estimating, Operations, or customers to support project pursuits, repeat business, and executable project solutions.

For this role, we anticipate paying $150K - $200K per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here .

Who We Are

As a Koch Engineered Solutions company, DEPCOM Power is a leading energy solutions partner for the utility solar and broader energy industries, providing project development support, engineering, procurement and construction, energy storage, repowering and operations and maintenance services. Our highly skilled team of conventional and renewable power industry experts work to deliver the lowest cost of energy and the highest rate of return.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. new_jobs.title: Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Tucuvi, we help healthcare organizations ensure every patient receives timely high-quality care by augmenting clinical teams with AI.

Our clinical-grade AI Care Management platform automates and orchestrates high-volume workflows end to end, combining autonomous AI agents including LOLA, our Voice Clinical Agent with workflow logic, escalation, documentation, and seamless integration into existing health system infrastructure. Built for trust and clinical reality, Tucuvi is the first Class IIb Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) for Voice AI driven patient management.

Today, we support 50+ care pathways across 80+ healthcare organizations, delivering up to 80% automation of nursing workflows, >90% patient engagement, and improved clinical outcomes. We recently raised $20M in Series A funding to scale across Europe and the US.

CONTEXT

We expand care team capacity by executing agentic voice workflows for pharmacy refill outreach, post-discharge follow-up, care-gap closure, chronic care check-ins, and scheduling, among others. The common thread is high-volume workflows where clinical teams can't keep up with the outreach patients need.

You don't need deep clinical expertise in every pathway. You will be supported by clinical subject-matter experts, Solutions Engineers, and a Product team in Madrid who own protocol design, conversation flows, and escalation logic. What you need is the operating discipline to take what they build, deploy it inside a real health system, prove with data that it's working, and build the case for what comes next.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your mission is to turn our US health system partnerships into programs that deliver measurable outcomes, expand into new use cases, and become the reference accounts that open the next ten doors. This role requires up to 25–30% travel for go-lives, strategic reviews, and onsite work with customer teams.

You'll own the full lifecycle of a health system relationship from the first site implementation through multi-site expansion and new use case discovery. You'll work directly with care managers, nurses, call center staff, and pharmacy techs as well as decision-makers from directors to VP-level champions. You're the person the customer calls first, and the person who shapes what they ask for next.

Internally, you'll translate what you learn on the ground into product priorities, expansion strategies, and the evidence that makes our next sale easier. You are the operator who makes the program work and the strategist who makes it grow.

You bring the structure, the rigor, the commercial instinct, and the accountability our customers need to maintain a thriving program.

We're growing rapidly in the US, so you will have room for career progression and development.

WHAT TO EXPECT FURING YOUR FIRST MONTHS WITH US

During the first 3 months:
Onboarding and training to get you up to speed on our platform, our workflows, and the accounts you'll own. You'll be running site implementations independently well by month three: kick-off meetings, workflow mapping sessions with clinical staff, platform configuration alongside our clinical and product team, go-live, and first-line support. You'll also be building relationships with the director-level champions who will determine whether these accounts expand.

From month 3 to 6:
You will run multiple concurrent deployments and own the KPI reporting cadence for your accounts. You should be able tell the difference between a metric that's noisy and a metric that's telling you something. You're actively identifying where the next use case or site expansion sits and starting to build the case for it using the customer's data.

By month 12:
You've driven at least one account expansion beyond the initial scope. You've turned what you learned into a repeatable rollout and growth model. You're the person the customer's VP level leadership trusts to tell them what's working, what isn't, and what to do next and the person our Sales team brings into new opportunities because your accounts are the proof.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Drive account growth, not just delivery.
You own activation end to end but the job doesn't end at go-live. You identify expansion opportunities (new sites, new use cases, new pathways), build the business case with the customer's outcomes data, and partner with Sales to close. Delivery is how we earn the right to grow.

Frame the case for leadership.
When a health system's VP asks "is this working and should we expand," you don't hand them a dashboard, you build the narrative: what the data says, what it means, what you'd recommend, and what it would take. This is the skill that turns a single-site pilot into a system-wide program.

Own the workflow translation between the customer and our product team.
You observe how clinical teams actually work from call flow, cadence, handoff logic, edge cases, and bring that back with enough specificity that our Clinical and Product teams can build the right thing. You make sure the people who do have what they need from the field, and you own whether the result holds up once it's live.

Define and measure the KPIs that matter.
Own the metrics for your accounts reach rate, engagement, confirmation rate, escalation volume, staff time freed, clinical outcomes and know what "good" looks like for each. Spot the trends before anyone asks, and translate usage data into a value story the health system's leadership will use to justify the next investment.

Build and maintain VP-level champion relationships.
The directors and VPs who sponsor your programs are the people who decide whether this account doubles or plateaus. You cultivate those relationships deliberately not just with delivery results, but with strategic insight about what their organization should do next.

Build trust with clinical staff.
LOLA only works if the people using it believe in it. You're the person in the room earning the respect of clinicians by listening well, responding fast, and proving it with outcomes.

Own the feedback loop to Product and Engineering.
Distinguish a bug from a real feature gap from scope creep, and bring it back to the team with enough clarity that they can act on it. Your field perspective directly shapes what gets built next.

Scale with efficiency.
Manage concurrent workstreams without compromising quality, and turn what you learn into processes and playbooks other people can run.

REQUIREMENTS

8–12 years of relevant experience, with a track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder programs end to end including at least one where you drove expansion or growth beyond the original scope, not just delivered it.

Previous experience in one or more of the following (helpful):

Strategic account management or client partnership at a healthcare technology or services company

Health system program management implementation, expansion planning, change management, or process design

Clinical workflow redesign, care transformation, or process improvement inside a hospital or health system

Growth instinct, not just delivery discipline.
You've spotted the adjacent opportunity, built the case, and acted not waited for someone to ask. In interviews, we'll ask you to walk us through a specific example.

Strong, demonstrable project management skills.
You build the plan, you run the plan, you know where every dependency sits. Multiple parallel workstreams without losing control.

You lead with scoping, not assumptions.
Your first move in a new account is to map the process, identify the gaps between what was sold and what's real, and adjust the plan before problems find you.

Comfort building a financial narrative.
You can translate operational metrics into a business case a VP will act on. If you've built an ROI model or an expansion proposal for a client, that's a strong signal.

A self-service-first approach to problem solving.
You try it before you ask about it.

US-based, with up to 25–30% travel for go-lives, strategic reviews, and onsite work. You'll also work in close partnership with our Spain-based team, bringing a US perspective to Tucuvi as we continue building it into a truly global healthtech company.

WHAT WE’LL ASK YOU TO SHOW US

A program or customer you grew beyond its original scope what you identified, how you built the case, and what happened

A project plan you built and ran not one you inherited

A problem you caught before it escalated, and the signal that tipped you off

THIS IS NOT THE ROLE FOR YOU IF

You think the job ends at go-live

You deliver scope but don't look for what comes next

You aren't interested in helping design a better repeatable playbook for others

You measure success in tickets closed, not outcomes achieved

You'd rather escalate the hard conversation with clinical staff than have it

You need to be the domain expert rather than the person who makes domain experts effective

WHAT WE OFFER

$140K–$160K base + variable + equity (based on experience)

Remote work (Boston, NYC, West Coast preferred)

Flexible working hours

Team buildings (at least tw...

new_jobs.title: Project Manager - Stormwater
new_jobs.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

At Jacobs, we challenge- what’s accepted, so we can shape innovative and lasting solutions for tomorrow. If you’re interested in a long and rewarding career working with one of the highest ranked design firms in ENR’s list of Top 500 Design Firms, and with the industry’s best and most innovative engineers, then Jacobs is where you belong. We are looking for an enthusiastic and highly-motivated team member to work on a variety of stormwater collection and conveyance, wastewater collection and conveyance, and site civil design projects as a Project Manager in our water market. Are you ready to take your career to the next level? By joining our team you’ll have the opportunity to lead the planning and design of wastewater and stormwater collection and conveyance systems and assist more senior engineers on larger, more complex projects. This position will support both local and national wastewater and stormwater projects. As part of our growing team, you’ll be responsible for performing all aspects of engineering. We are looking for a passionate team member who has a good understanding of engineering principles, theories, and concepts and has a desire to work on the planning, design and construction of wastewater conveyance, stormwater conveyance, green stormwater infrastructure, and site civil projects. We’re seeking self-motivated professionals with a desire to grow personally as well as professionally with each project in our diverse and fast-paced office. If you’re up for the challenge, we’ve been looking for someone just like you. Join us and we will support you in continuing the development of your skills and exploring all that you can do across our global company, with opportunities to share your knowledge along the way.

Here's What You’ll Be Doing

Collaborate and work with a multi-disciplinary team in the delivery of wastewater, water resources, and site civil design projects.
Conduct preliminary engineering by analyzing data, performing calculations, and evaluating options to develop the best solution and make recommendation.
Autonomously evaluate and improve the selection and/or modification of standard techniques, procedures, criteria, and systems to efficiently meet project goals.
Technical writing, reviewing, and providing clear, concise input to investigations, memorandums, or solutions reports.
Prepare drawings and specifications as well as changes to drawings based on engineering staff and supervisor markups, edits, QA/QC comments and/or suggestions.
Communicate and coordinate information with other engineering disciplines and company offices.
Review work performed by others for adequacy on completion.
Attend project meetings, coordinate work with project team members, supervisor/client.
Interface directly with our clients.
Mentor and support junior staff in the local and regional water group.
Participate in professional organizations for marketing, industry recognition, networking, and building the Jacobs brand.
Position may include supervision of one or more project engineers as a task manager on a large project, or as a project manager of small projects.

At Jacobs, we’re partnering across the globe to create the best project outcomes by maximizing the design, digital technology, and support capabilities of our Global Integrated Delivery (GID) teammates. By joining Jacobs, you’ll commit to supporting and engaging with these teams, as we work to build a company like no other. Jacobs’ health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Typical benefits offered include flexible work schedules and opportunities to work remotely, educational reimbursement, retirement benefits, employee stock purchase plan, health benefits, disability benefits, life and accident insurance, voluntary benefits, paid time off and paid holidays, and parental leave.

Here's what you'll need

Bachelors Degree in Civil, Water Resources, or Environmental Engineering
Virginia PE license or have the ability to obtain within six months of hire
Ability to efficiently utilize time in executing assigned tasks accurately and within schedule
Proficient knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint)
Ability and desire to use production tools, such as ESRI ArcGIS, AutoCAD, computer graphic and design programs, and hydraulic modeling software
Applied knowledge of basic engineering principles and prescribed methods
Analytical and technical problem-solving skills
Self-motivation, team-oriented work practices, top-notch organizational skills, and the ability to effectively multi-task in a fast-paced environment
Working knowledge and understanding of local and state design codes and standards
At least 5 years of professional experience in water resources engineering and related experience
